author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as two music notes: the leaf was a note head at the end of the stem, and the flower was a heart-shaped blob. Now the left stem continues past its leaf and bends to the bottom as in the reference, with the leaf branching off as a pointed lens. The right stem ends in a hanging tulip bell: dome, straight sides, two petals opening downward.
omissions: the tulip's middle petal (no room at 8 spacing)
